definitions.explanation: In a short while, without needing to do anything: something will happen on its own before long.

examples.japanese: じきに⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You'll get used to it soon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧じきに⟦{止|や}む→止む：01153_yamu⟧でしょう。
examples.english: The rain will probably stop before long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}しなくて→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧じきに⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me not to worry, that the fever would come down soon.

notes:
Often written {直|じき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Common in conversation and a little old-fashioned in tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: right away, immediately; also used for actions a person takes
- ⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧: very soon; the time is close (⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧だ)
- ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧: some time or other; vaguer about when

WATCH OUT:
{直|じか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (directly, in person) uses the same kanji but is a different word.
